text: 知名量化私募天算量化（北京）资本管理有限公司被上海期货交易所处罚。近日，上海期货交易所披露的一则违规处理决定公告显示，今年2月12日，都健使用本人账户、天算指增保护专享2号私募证券投资基金账户，在白银期权合约上相互交易，扰乱市场秩序。
text_en: Well-known quantitative private fund manager Tiansuan Quantitative (Beijing) Capital Management Co., Ltd. was penalized by the Shanghai Futures Exchange. A recent disciplinary decision disclosed by the SHFE shows that on February 12 this year, Du Jian used his personal account and the Tiansuan Index Enhancement Protection Exclusive No. 2 private securities investment fund account to trade with each other in silver options contracts, disrupting market order.
